relations.support_notes: His being abbot of gSang phu ne'u thog monastery for 13 years is only supported by three sources. Another three sources do not record him as an abbot. Yet another source records him as an abbot for three years, not 13 years. The main reason for the confusion here is probably that he did not actually serve as the abbot of the whole monastery but only as the abbot for the upper college. Tibetan historiographers might have problems with where to place him.
